## What's new

- MENU > Game List View: Normal, the games as the UI Theme shows them, or
  List, a scrolling list in the menus' style with the system's name and
  where you are (3 / 120) at the top and a dot beside favorites.
- In the list, up and down move, left and right jump by letter, and L1
  and R1 skip a screenful. A, X, Y and B do what they do on the shelf.
- Not offered in Cubic, which plays games straight from the cube.

---

ChaOS 0.10.5 for the TrimUI Brick and Brick Hammer.

**Install or update** with [ChaOS Installer](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS-Installer/releases/latest), or write `ChaOS-v0.10.5-brick.img.xz` to a card yourself (that erases it).

ChaOS is built on [TortOS 2.1.1](https://github.com/ericreinsmidt/TortOS/releases/tag/v2.1.1) by Eric Reinsmidt. `ChaOS-v0.10.5-brick-sources.tar` is the source of everything in the image; what came from where is in [CREDITS.md](https://github.com/SkyWalker541/ChaOS/blob/main/CREDITS.md).
